integrity: The proof is unbounded and self-contained apart from Fermat's theorem and elementary multiplicative-order facts. Finite computation is corroborative only. Full-body access to the 2007 primary article was unavailable during review, so that access limitation is retained as an originality risk rather than being converted into a noncoverage claim.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the nonsquarefree/even part of the \(\Omega(n)=3\) layer for \(\beta(n)\mid2^n-1\). It does not classify the odd squarefree solutions \(pqr\), nor address larger multiplicity.
title: The nonsquarefree three-factor layer of a Mersenne prime-factor-sum divisibility
